name: token-ledger
description: Records tokens spent per session and per 5-hour plan window, pauses near the 5-hour or weekly limit and resumes after the reset

pauseAtPercent.title: Pause at % used
pauseAtPercent.description: Stop the running turn when the 5-hour or weekly limit reaches this percentage (50-100)

autoResume.title: Auto-resume after reset
autoResume.description: Send a 'continue' prompt once the limit that paused the session has reset
